**Read this first.** Nothing in this release has been played, and neither has 0.12.0 before it.
Every change passes the automated gate and the build log in `docs/releases.md` says what each
piece was read against. If you would rather wait for a build somebody has walked, wait for
0.13.1.

## The Road North

The maps between Montserrat and Montaillou -- the Plains, the Mountain Pass, the three ogre
caves and the Abandoned Cave -- are a corridor you fight through twice with almost nothing to
say for themselves. This release gives the road its voice back, mostly out of lines the game
already wrote.

**The Plains.** Your spirit companion warns you about the Dark Inquisitors on the line all three
spirits carry, voiced, and none of them ever spoke. The rogues' ritual -- which Bishop Diego
describes, which the rogues themselves boast of, and which nothing ever ran -- now finishes
itself as the last of them fall, and something answers it; join them instead and it rises bound,
theirs, until you turn on them. The Inquisition's crosses, which mark where a witch's blood was
strongest, can be read, and a perceptive traveller can see that the ring around the cult's fire
was pulled up and re-set to make room for the circle. A Wielder of the hidden street and a Dark
Wielder with Relican's mark each get their own greeting from the cult. A sworn Inquisitor can
help Bishop Diego as a brother of the Order rather than a hired sword, and report the whole thing
to Torquemada, who would rather it were not written down.

**Shylocke's collector.** The three men camped on the road are Shylocke's, waiting for debtors
leaving Barcelona -- and to anyone who never took his loan they were anonymous bandits who said
nothing. Now they say whose men they are, and the robbery can be haggled down, seen through,
lied past with Speech, or talked out of by the guild, the Church, or nine different skills and
perks. The debt can be argued down to Shylocke's own rate. And the oldest bug in the scene is
fixed: frightening them into forgiving the debt now actually clears Shylocke's ledger in
Barcelona, instead of leaving him demanding money he has been paid.

**The mountains.** The ogres of the Pyrenees were charmed by a Daeva and set on the Titans --
the Woozy Ogre says so, and so does a line of Aka Manah's that no player could reach. Nothing
ever lifted it. Now both of his endings do: kill him or talk him into leaving, and the tribe
stands down across the Pass, the Sprawl and the Cave, mid-swing. The rock titans and the wolves
are not charmed, and do not stand down. Tremblethorn's eight unreachable nodes give up the line
that explains the war, a way to be let go (which leaves the charm on), and a lie about the Titans
of Toulouse that sends him away to check -- and his second greeting stops accusing strangers of
ignoring a warning he never gave.

**Bernat Sicre.** The Abandoned Cave was 506 parts of wolves and nothing else. It now has a
Toulouse wool merchant in it, six weeks into a two-day crossing, camped behind two hired swords
who are the only reason the wolves have not had him. He sells what he is stuck with, he will
tell you what Montaillou is like before you walk into it, his wounded man can be treated with a
draught out of your own pack -- and when the charm breaks and the mountain road opens, he pays
you what he can and goes.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over any earlier release. **Nearly all of it
is level parts:** a character who has not entered the Plains, the Mountain Pass, the Ogre Sprawl,
the Ogre Cave, the Ogre Conjurer Cave or the Abandoned Cave. Shylocke's collector is dialogue and
works on any save that has not yet tripped his camp.
